These terms apply to the TANDA website and waitlist. They do not govern any bank account. If TANDA accounts become available, they will be subject to a separate account agreement and disclosures.

1. Acceptance of these terms

These Terms of Use ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the TANDA website and waitlist (the "Services"), operated by TANDA ("TANDA," "we," "us" or "our"). By using the Services, you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy notice. If you do not agree, do not use the Services.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old and located in the United States to join the waitlist. By joining, you confirm that the information you provide is accurate and belongs to you.

3. No offer of accounts or financial services

TANDA is a financial technology company, not a bank. TANDA accounts are not currently available. The Services are informational. Nothing in the Services is an offer to open a deposit account, an offer of credit, or a solicitation to buy or sell any financial product. Descriptions of planned products, features, fees and benefits are subject to the Important disclosures and may change.

4. The waitlist

Joining the waitlist does not reserve an account, guarantee eligibility, guarantee approval or create any customer relationship. Any future account application will be subject to identity verification and the partner bank's requirements. We may contact waitlisted users in the order and manner we choose, and we may end the waitlist at any time.

5. Communications

By joining the waitlist, you consent to receive emails from TANDA about our products and launch. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any email. We will not send text messages unless you separately agree to receive them.

6. No financial advice

Content in the Services is general information only and is not financial, legal, tax or investment advice. Consider consulting a qualified professional about your situation.

7. Intellectual property

The Services and their content, including text, graphics, artwork, logos and the "tanda." name and wordmark, are owned by TANDA or its licensors and are protected by intellectual property laws. You may view and print pages for your personal, non-commercial use. You may not copy, modify, distribute or create derivative works from the Services without our written permission.

8. Acceptable use

You agree not to:

  • Submit false information or someone else's information.
  • Interfere with or disrupt the Services, or attempt to gain unauthorized access to any system.
  • Use automated means to access the Services or submit sign-ups.
  • Use the Services for any unlawful purpose.

9. Third-party links and services

The Services may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for their content or practices, and your use of them is at your own risk and subject to their terms.

10. Disclaimers

The Services are provided "as is" and "as available," without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy and non-infringement, to the fullest extent permitted by law. We do not warrant that the Services will be uninterrupted, error-free or secure.

11. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, TANDA and its officers, employees and agents will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages, or any loss of data or profits, arising from your use of the Services. Our total liability for any claim relating to the Services will not exceed one hundred U.S. dollars ($100).

Some jurisdictions do not allow certain limitations of liability, so some of these limitations may not apply to you.

12. Indemnification

You agree to indemnify and hold TANDA harmless from claims, losses and expenses, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from your violation of these Terms or misuse of the Services.

13. Changes to the Services and these Terms

We may change, suspend or discontinue the Services at any time. We may update these Terms by posting a new version here and updating the "Last updated" date. Continued use after an update means you accept the updated Terms.

14. Governing law

These Terms are governed by applicable U.S. federal law and the laws of the state in which TANDA is organized, without regard to conflict-of-law principles, except where the law of your state of residence requires otherwise.

15. Language

These Terms are provided in English and Spanish. If there is any conflict between the versions, the English version controls to the extent permitted by law.

16. General

If any provision of these Terms is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions will remain in effect. Our failure to enforce a provision is not a waiver. These Terms, together with the Privacy notice, are the entire agreement between you and TANDA regarding the Services.
